title: File:Ph locator camarines sur naga.png
description:
Map of Camarines Sur showing the location of Naga
Background of Naga
The 3rd Philippine city granted the title of 'Royal' (after Manila and Cebu) by King Philip II and the Ecclesiastical seat of the Bishop of the entire Bicol region and almost half of Southern Luzon for three centuries centuries, Naga, or formerly known as the Royal City of Nueva Caceres (New Caceres), is the Queen City of Bicol. The title of 'Queen City' is used in the context of the historical significance. For hundreds of years Naga has been the center of trade, education, religion, culture and healthcare in the region. This notion is further re-enforced since the Queen and Principal Patroness of Bicol, the miraculous image of Our Lady of Penafrancia, resides in Naga.

title: File:Revised Seal of the Naga Metropolitan Cathedral.png
description:
The revised (2022) seal of the Naga Metropolitan Cathedral contains an image of the Church's facade. 
Below it is a scroll bearing the words "Metropolitan Cathedral," signifying its status as the Mother Church of the Ecclesiastical Province of Caceres.
The year 1595 signifies the year in which the then-Diocese of Caceres was created, which thus elevated the Church or Parish to the status and dignity of a Cathedral.

These symbols are enshrined in a blue circle. In it are two Fleur-de-lis symbols, indicative of the Blessed Virgin Mary, Our Lady of Peñafrancia, whose image is annually brought to the Cathedral for nine-days of novena.

title: File:Naga bazar zero point Bagmara.jpg
description:
Naga Bazar Zero Point — Katila, Bagmara, Rajshahi
Naga Bazar Zero Point is developing as an important road junction near the central area of Katila village, Bagmara, Rajshahi. From dawn to dusk, a considerable number of vehicles pass through and stop here every day. Rickshaws, auto-rickshaws, and vans are generally available, making the point an important local transportation and communication hub.

The name “Naga Bazar Zero Point” was chosen by the late Gaher Ali Mondal, founder of Naga Bazar. After naming the place, he personally hung a banner bearing the name “Naga Bazar Zero Point” at the location. Today, the point is a familiar local junction for Katila and surrounding areas.

title: File:Paintings on the Wall of Cave 1, Ajanta Caves, Maharashtra, India 19.jpg
description:
Painting of Sanghapal Jataka on the walls of Cave no 1, Ajanta Caves, Maharashtra, India.
In the upper left, the Naga king Sankhapala is sitting on his throne and listening to a wise man (. In the upper right, many men are pulling Sankhapala (depicted in serpent form) by a rope through his nose but is stopped by Aḷara who offers his cows in exchange for Sankhapala's release. In the lower left, Sankhapala invites Aḷara to visit his underwater kingdom. 
The painting has washed out in several places and can be understood only after referring old versions. 

The Ajanta Caves are 30 rock-cut Buddhist cave monuments dating from the second century BCE to about 480 CE in Aurangabad district of Maharashtra state in India. Ajanta Caves are a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The caves are universally regarded as masterpieces of Buddhist religious art.

description:

Kasama natin sa talakayan sina Naga City Mayor at former Vice President Leni Robredo, Sen. Bam Aquino, at Baguio City Mayor Benjie Magalong.
Nakasama rin natin sina Naga City IT Officer Ruel Oliver, Metro Clark ICT Council Dr. Francisco Villanueva, Mayor Jarold Peña ng San Jose, Camarines Sur, at ICT Council of Bicol Chairperson Efren Daniel De Leon, kasama ang iba pang ICT councils, startups, investors, at development partners.

Kailangan natin ng mas maayos na internet connectivity sa kanayunan, mas pinalakas na agricultural extension services, integrated data systems para sa food security at climate response, at matibay na ugnayan ng LGUs, national government, academe, at private sector.
Dahil sa huli, 𝗮𝗻𝗴 𝗳𝗼𝗼𝗱 𝘀𝗲𝗰𝘂𝗿𝗶𝘁𝘆 𝗮𝘆 𝗵𝗶𝗻𝗱𝗶 𝘁𝗿𝗮𝗯𝗮𝗵𝗼 𝗻𝗴 𝗶𝗶𝘀𝗮𝗻𝗴 𝘀𝗲𝗸𝘁𝗼𝗿 𝗹𝗮𝗺𝗮𝗻𝗴—𝗶𝘁𝗼 𝗮𝘆 𝘀𝗮𝗺𝗮-𝘀𝗮𝗺𝗮𝗻𝗴 𝗿𝗲𝘀𝗽𝗼𝗻𝘀𝗶𝗯𝗶𝗹𝗶𝗱𝗮𝗱 𝗻𝗴 𝗯𝘂𝗼𝗻𝗴 𝘀𝗮𝗺𝗯𝗮𝘆𝗮𝗻𝗮𝗻.
Sa tulong ng ICT at innovation, mas nagiging posible ang isang Pilipinas na handa sa climate shocks, mas matatag ang agrikultura, at siguradong may pagkain sa hapag ng bawat pamilyang Pilipino.

Dios mabalos sa Naga City at sa lahat ng partners sa patuloy na pagsusulong ng isang mas matalino, mas matatag, at mas inklusibong kinabukasan para sa ating bansa. 🇵🇭
